idea: a prayer for someone starting a new job and feeling like they are not good enough
original_angle: Tired after a first day is not failure; it is the feeling of growing. The prayer asks for one kind coworker and one small win, not for confidence.
title: A prayer for your first week at a new job
hook: New job this week, scared you don't belong.

scenes.text: New job this week, scared you don't belong. This one is for you.

visual.prompt: person walking into office building early morning, soft light, from behind

scenes.text: Lord, you already know the name on the desk and the fear in the chest. Walk in with them.

visual.prompt: empty desk by a window with morning light, slow push in

scenes.text: Quiet the voice that says they got lucky. They were chosen. Let them believe it for one whole day.

visual.prompt: hands typing on laptop, close up, shallow focus, natural light

scenes.text: Give them one kind coworker, one small win, and the courage to ask a question out loud before lunch.

visual.prompt: two colleagues smiling over coffee in a bright kitchen

scenes.text: And when they get home tired, remind them: tired is not the same as failing. It is the feeling of growing.

visual.prompt: person on a train at sunset looking out the window, calm

scenes.text: Be still, and know that I am God. Psalm 46:10. You're not on your own in that building. Amen.

visual.prompt: brand card, Psalm 46:10 reference, soft gradient

close: If that was for you, save it for Monday morning. Come back tomorrow, there's one for you then too.
description:
A short prayer for anyone starting a new job and fighting the feeling that they do not belong. You were chosen. Tired is not failing.

New prayers and encouragement every day.

quotes.text: Be still, and know that I am God.
